gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Wide, bright lowercase counters make Noto Sans Gothic read like drilled glass beads, while Offside spreads its unclosed curves wide. Nudge the body size up a touch and it settles in nicely.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Noto Sans Grantha has tall little letters whose bowls look pressed flat, so reading never snags on a closed shape. And Offside, drawn in one uninterrupted monoline stroke, takes the commanding display role.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-gujarati: Clean curved strokes in Noto Sans Gujarati stop before turning inward, while Offside's twine-like lines press flat across the page. Offside makes statements; the body does the quiet explaining.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-gunjala-gond: Offside's curves refuse to close, giving the whole heading a smooth drawn-wire feel. But Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi brings real openness, its terminals cut back to leave a big gap.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-gurmukhi: Offside holds a single unbroken line weight from terminals to junctions, while Noto Sans Gurmukhi's outward-pointing terminals look like tongs. Shrink the heading and its commanding presence thins out fast.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Expressive and wire-thick throughout, Offside leads with tracked, unclosed curves. Noto Sans Hanunoo follows with lowercase filling most of the height and open terminals that make long reading easy.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Commanding in a drafting-pen way, Offside holds one steady line, while Noto Sans Hebrew gives lowercase a dominant midsection and wide gaps. Paragraphs in it should move along smoothly, without snagging.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-hk: Noto Sans HK comes in large, lifted-brush lowercase forms. Offside's constant stroke and unclosed curves supply the command, and the pair's real strength is that sheer difference in presence.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-imperial-ara: Offside has a pen-plotter smoothness, its curves refusing to close along widely tracked lines. And Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic grows unwieldy if the body is enlarged much beyond its natural size.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-jp: Noto Sans JP reads tall and open, its curves sweeping wide. Against Offside's pipe-cleaner strokes and tracked, unclosed curves, that openness is what makes the pair stand apart.
